fact: Statistics Botswana and the University of Botswana launched the second Botswana Strategy for Development of Statistics (BSDS 2026-2030), a five-year national roadmap for the statistical system; no launch date is given, so the document's published date is used.
PARIS21 states Botswana validated, endorsed and launched its second Botswana Strategy for the Development of Statistics (BSDS II, covering 12 sectors) in October 2025; no period is given.
Statistics Botswana's 2023/24 annual report states it secured PARIS21 support in that financial year to develop BSDS II for 2025-2029; year end 31 March 2024 used as the date.
The report states the first BSDS (BSDS I) covered 2015-2020 and was extended from April 2020 to March 2023, so it has ended.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): BSDS 2026-2030.
